claims.text: Adult guidelines: cyclosporine = second-line for severe, steroid-refractory or steroid-dependent DRESS
claims.quote: Current adult guidelines recommend cyclosporine as a second‐line therapy for severe, steroid‐refractory, or steroid‐dependent DRESS cases.
claims.locator: EAACI position paper on drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) in children (Pediatr Allergy Immunol, 2025)
